name: Analytical and Numerical Ability
definition: Works with numbers, compares information, identifies patterns and draws logical conclusions.

name: Digital and Technical Ability
definition: Uses digital tools, learns systems and resolves basic technical problems.

name: Communication
definition: Explains, listens, writes and adapts messages clearly and professionally.

name: Organisation and Attention to Detail
definition: Plans work, follows procedures, manages records and identifies errors.

name: Problem-Solving
definition: Identifies causes, evaluates options and selects practical evidence-based actions.

name: People and Teamwork
definition: Cooperates, supports shared goals and works respectfully with different people.

name: Leadership and Decision-Making
definition: Takes responsibility, guides others and makes accountable decisions.

name: Conflict Management and Emotional Regulation
definition: Remains calm, listens, handles criticism and resolves disagreement fairly.

name: Initiative, Creativity and Adaptability
definition: Acts without constant prompting, improves processes and adjusts to change.

name: Commercial and Entrepreneurial Thinking
definition: Recognises opportunities, understands customer value, costs, revenue and calculated risk.
